name: Cathode
description: Cathode component of a battery cell. Captures active material chemistry (e.g. NMC, LFP, NCA), supplier and part reference. Required for material disclosure under EU Battery Regulation Art. 13.

leaf_properties.label: Active Material Chemistry
leaf_properties.description: Active cathode material type. Common abbreviations: NMC = Lithium Nickel Manganese Cobalt Oxide, LFP = Lithium Iron Phosphate, NCA = Lithium Nickel Cobalt Aluminium Oxide.

leaf_properties.label: Material Supplier
leaf_properties.description: Name of the cathode active material supplier.

leaf_properties.label: Part Number
leaf_properties.description: Supplier part number or internal cathode component identifier.

metadata.note: Subtype of the generic Component brick, specific to cathode active material disclosure.
